newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France makes no net injection at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France makes no net injection at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France made no net drain or injection at a securities repurchase tender held on Thursday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Friday.
It accepted bids for 41.1 billion francs in new liquidity, the same amount as the 41.1 billion leaving the market on Friday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on July 7.
The Bank of France said it allocated 12.3 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 4.2 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 28.8 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 12.3 percent of this demand.
